init_distributed_mode: initialize distributed training mode for SLURM multi-GPU or single-GPU jobs using params object
init_signal_handler: install SLURM signal handlers for job pre-emption and time limit SIGUSR1 signals
sig_handler: handle SLURM SIGUSR1 signal to requeue the job on the master process
term_handler: handle and bypass SIGTERM signals to prevent premature job termination on SLURM
review_init_distributed_mode: review the init_distributed_mode function to understand SLURM and torch distributed initialization logic
